_comment: Registry of the plugins Octo Jotter ships compiled in.
Same schema as the community registry at plugins/registry.json, and read
through the same RegistryIndex adapter — the only difference is that
manifestUrl uses the asset: scheme, so these resolve from inside the APK
and need no network. A built-in must work offline and must not depend on
permissions here MUST match the manifest each entry points at. The install
path refuses a plugin whose manifest asks for more than its listing
declared (see undeclaredPermissions), and that check applies to these too.
